turns.text: Don't worry if you don't understand every single thing.
turns.zh: 要是你没法每个字都听懂，别担心。

turns.text: Just listen first and then we will break it down for you.
turns.zh: 先听着，然后我们再给你拆开讲。

turns.text: We will go through it and we will explain everything in the simplest way.
turns.zh: 我们会过一遍，用最简单的方式把一切都解释清楚。

turns.text: Let's see how people ask for a favor in everyday situations.
turns.zh: 咱们来看看人们在日常场合是怎么请人帮忙的。
